i) Polynomial Regression Model 


```{r}
library(caret)

library(dplyr)

set.seed(598)


train_idx <- createDataPartition(df$Concrete_compressive_strength, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[train_idx, ]
test_data <- df[-train_idx, ]

concrete_lm <- lm(Concrete_compressive_strength ~ ., data = train_data)
summary(concrete_lm)

```

`


```{r}
library(Metrics)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(598)
predictors <- c("Cement", "blast_furnace_slag", "fly_ash", "Water","Superplasticizer", "Coarse_aggregate", "Fine_Aggreggate", "Age")
response <- "Concrete_compressive_strength"

train_idx <- createDataPartition(df[[response]], p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[train_idx, ]
test_data <- df[-train_idx, ]

k <- 10
folds <- sample(1:k, nrow(train_data), replace=TRUE)
max_degree <- 10
cv_results <- data.frame(Degree=integer(), CV_RMSE=numeric(), CV_R2=numeric())

for(d in 1:max_degree){
  rmse_folds <- c()
  r2_folds <- c()
  
  for(f in 1:k){
    train_fold <- train_data[folds != f, ]
    val_fold   <- train_data[folds == f, ]
    
    poly_terms <- paste0("poly(", predictors, ",", d, ", raw=FALSE)")
    formula_poly <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", paste(poly_terms, collapse=" + ")))
    
    model <- lm(formula_poly, data=train_fold)
    
    pred <- predict(model, newdata=val_fold)
    obs <- val_fold[[response]]
    
    rmse_folds <- c(rmse_folds, rmse(obs, pred))
    ss_res <- sum((obs - pred)^2)
    ss_tot <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)
    r2_folds <- c(r2_folds, 1 - ss_res/ss_tot)
  }
  
  cv_results <- rbind(cv_results, data.frame(
    Degree=d,
    CV_RMSE=mean(rmse_folds),
    CV_R2=mean(r2_folds)
  ))
}

for(i in 1:nrow(cv_results)){
  cat(paste0("Degree: ", cv_results$Degree[i],"  | CV RMSE: ", round(cv_results$CV_RMSE[i],4),"  | CV R2: ", round(cv_results$CV_R2[i],4), "\n"))
}
```




```{r}
degree <- 5

poly_terms <- paste0("poly(", predictors, ", ", degree, ", raw=FALSE)")
formula_poly <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", paste(poly_terms, collapse=" + ")))

poly_model <- lm(formula_poly, data=train_data)
summary(poly_model)

pred <- predict(poly_model, newdata=test_data)
obs <- test_data[[response]]

test_mse <- mse(obs, pred)
test_rmse <- rmse(obs, pred)
test_mae <- mae(obs, pred)

ss_res <- sum((obs - pred)^2)
ss_tot <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)
test_r2 <- 1 - ss_res/ss_tot

cat("Test MSE:", round(test_mse,4), "\n")
cat("Test RMSE:", round(test_rmse,4), "\n")
cat("Test MAE:", round(test_mae,4), "\n")
cat("Test R²:", round(test_r2,4), "\n")
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data=test_data, aes(x=obs, y=pred)) +
  geom_point(color='darkred', alpha=0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color='black', linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title=paste("Degree", degree, "Polynomial Regression: Predicted vs Actual"),
       x="Actual Compressive Strength",
       y="Predicted Compressive Strength") +
  theme_minimal()

```

ii) Splines model 

```{r}
set.seed(598)
library(splines)
library(caret)

train_idx <- createDataPartition(df$Concrete_compressive_strength, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- df[-train_idx, ]


mse <- function(y, yhat) mean((y - yhat)^2)


predictors <- setdiff(names(df), "Concrete_compressive_strength")

degrees_of_freedom <- 1:10
mse_values <- numeric(length(degrees_of_freedom))

suppressWarnings({
  for (i in seq_along(degrees_of_freedom)) {
    d <- degrees_of_freedom[i]
    rhs <- paste(sprintf("bs(%s, df=%d)", predictors, d), collapse = " + ")
    fml <- as.formula(paste("Concrete_compressive_strength ~", rhs))
    
    spline_model <- lm(fml, data = train_data)
    preds <- predict(spline_model, newdata = test_data)
    mse_values[i] <- mse(test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength, preds)
  }
})

splines_results <- data.frame(
  Degrees_of_Freedom = degrees_of_freedom,
  Test_MSE = round(mse_values, 4)
)

print("Spline Regression Model Comparison:")
print(splines_results)

```
```{r}
best_df <- splines_results$Degrees_of_Freedom[which.min(splines_results$Test_MSE)]
best_MSE <- min(splines_results$Test_MSE)
cat("Best degrees of freedom:", best_df, "\n")
cat("Best Test MSE for spline model:", best_MSE, "\n")
```





```{r}
suppressWarnings({
  rhs_best <- paste(sprintf("ns(%s, df=%d)", predictors, best_df), collapse = " + ")
  best_spline_formula <- as.formula(paste("Concrete_compressive_strength ~", rhs_best))
  best_spline_fit <- lm(best_spline_formula, data = train_data)
  spline_preds <- predict(best_spline_fit, newdata = test_data)
})


plot_data <- data.frame(
  Actual = test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength,
  Predicted = spline_preds
)


ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Spline Regression: Predicted vs Actual Compressive Strength",
    subtitle = paste("Best df =", best_df, " | Test MSE =", round(best_MSE, 2)),
    x = "Actual Strength (MPa)",
    y = "Predicted Strength (MPa)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

```

```{r}
summary(best_spline_fit)
```


```{r}
residuals <- test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength - spline_preds
resid_plot_data <- data.frame(
  Fitted = spline_preds,
  Residuals = residuals
)

ggplot(resid_plot_data, aes(x = Fitted, y = Residuals)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Spline Regression: Residuals vs Fitted Values",
    subtitle = paste("Best df =", best_df),
    x = "Fitted Strength (MPa)",
    y = "Residuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

```



iii) Regression Tree Model 


```{r}
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)

set.seed(598)
n <- nrow(df)
train_idx <- sample(1:n, size= 0.7*n)
train_data <- df[train_idx, ]
test_data <- df[-train_idx,]

df.tree <- rpart(Concrete_compressive_strength ~ . , data = train_data)
rpart.plot(df.tree)
```

```{r}
preds <- predict(df.tree, newdata=test_data)
rmse <- sqrt(mean((preds - test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength)^2))
cat("RMSE = ", rmse, "\n")
```

```{r}
SST <- sum((test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength - mean(train_data$Concrete_compressive_strength))^2)
SSR <- sum((preds - test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength)^2)
R_squared <- 1 - SSR/SST
cat("R-squared = ", R_squared, "\n")
```

```{r}
printcp(df.tree)
```

```{r}
plotcp(df.tree)
```

```{r}
optimal.cp <- df.tree$cptable[which.min(df.tree$cptable[,"xerror"]), "CP"]
df.tree.pruned <- prune(df.tree, cp = optimal.cp)
rpart.plot(df.tree.pruned)
```
```{r}
printcp(df.tree.pruned)
```


```{r}
plotcp(df.tree.pruned)
```


```{r}
preds_pruned <- predict(df.tree.pruned, newdata = test_data)
rmse_pruned <- sqrt(mean((preds_pruned - test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength)^2))
rmse_pruned
```

iv) Random Forest Model 


```{r}
library(randomForest)
randomForest(formula = Concrete_compressive_strength ~ ., 
             data = train_data, 
             ntree = 500, 
             mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(train_data) - 1)), 
             importance = TRUE)

```

```{r}
library(randomForest)
set.seed(598)
n <- nrow(df)
train_idx <- sample(1:n, size = 0.7*n)
train_data <- df[train_idx,]
test_data <- df[-train_idx, ]

rf_model <- randomForest(Concrete_compressive_strength ~ .,
                         data = train_data,
                         ntree=500,
                         mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(train_data)-1)),
                         importance = TRUE)
print(rf_model)
```

```{r}
rf_preds <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data)
rmse_rf <- sqrt(mean((rf_preds - test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength)^2))
cat("Random Forest RMSE = ", rmse_rf, "\n")
```

```{r}
SST <- sum((test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength - mean(train_data$Concrete_compressive_strength))^2)
SSR <- sum((rf_preds - test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength)^2)
R2_rf <- 1 - SSR/SST
cat("Random Forest R-squared = ", R2_rf, "\n")
```

```{r}

# === Model Performance Summary (using previously fitted models) ===
library(Metrics)
library(ggplot2)

# Ensure the same data split as used in the spline model
set.seed(598)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df$Concrete_compressive_strength, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- df[-train_idx, ]

# Recalculate spline predictions on this test set to match dimensions
spline_preds <- predict(best_spline_fit, newdata = test_data)

# Compute spline metrics
spline_rmse <- sqrt(best_MSE)
spline_r2 <- cor(test_data$Concrete_compressive_strength, spline_preds)^2

# Combine all previously fitted models
results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Polynomial (Degree 5)",
            "Regression Tree (Pruned)",
            "Spline (df = 7)",
            "Random Forest"),
  RMSE = round(c(test_rmse, rmse_pruned, spline_rmse, rmse_rf), 3),
  R2   = round(c(test_r2, R_squared, spline_r2, R2_rf), 3)
)

print(results)


```

```{r}
ggplot(results, aes(x = Model, y = RMSE, fill = Model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "RMSE Comparison Across Models",
    y = "Test RMSE",
    x = "Model"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#6B2E00")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Polynomial (Degree 5)" = "#8B0000",   
    "Regression Tree (Pruned)" = "#006400", 
    "Spline (df = 7)" = "#8B4513",          
    "Random Forest" = "#CC5500"             
  ))


```



Mathematical Formulas for Regression Models


$$
\hat{y} = \beta_0 + \sum_{j=1}^{p} \sum_{k=1}^{5} \beta_{jk} x_j^k + \varepsilon
$$
